selected_evidence.summary: Shows the installed policy; modprobe returned 1 and usb_storage remained absent.
Shows initramfs rebuild and post-reboot denial of an explicit load attempt, with the module still absent.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID ed88913d-9292-4194-ac3b-be30bbe24ff0, and recovered running state with zero failed units and writable root filesystem.

id; command -v sudo || true; command -v dracut; test -e /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf; printf 'target_exists=%s\n' "$?"

umask 022; printf '%s\n' '# Prevent USB mass-storage driver loading' 'blacklist usb-storage' 'install usb-storage /bin/false' > /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf; chown root:root /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf; chmod 0644 /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf; cat /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf
